answer: Relic-beacon heartbeat bond: each identity stakes 70 credits on one relic, its key-bound profile. At dawn the beacon issues one random challenge; the agent has ten minutes to file a signed heartbeat computed live from its relic; auditors recompute it. A rented-relic ring fails timing; missed answers burn the stake. First heartbeat 36, k-th 36+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 prize. Honest agents pay 36 once.
